faqs.question: Can MNCE deliver training at our workplace?
faqs.answer: Yes. On-site training is a core enquiry option. Tell us your location, course, equipment, approximate number of learners and preferred dates so we can discuss a suitable arrangement.

faqs.question: How do we request a corporate training quotation?
faqs.answer: Use the on-site booking form or WhatsApp us. We will need the training topic, employee count, venue and ideal dates to prepare a proposal.

faqs.question: Do listed individual prices apply to corporate on-site sessions?
faqs.answer: No. Advertised individual-course prices are reference prices from promotional material and may change. Corporate or off-site delivery requires its own quotation.

faqs.question: Are accommodation, PPE and Wi-Fi included?
faqs.answer: Some promotional training packages mention these benefits. Confirm availability and inclusion for your chosen course and venue before paying.

faqs.question: Are jobs guaranteed after training?
faqs.answer: Employment placement is not guaranteed by this website. Ask MNCE directly about any employment support or current opportunities.

faqs.question: How can I verify certification or accreditation?
faqs.answer: Request the current accreditation and course-specific certification details from MNCE before enrolment.
